preguntaEn: IF YOU ARE FORCED TO RETURN TO THE ROAD BEFORE STOPPING ON THE SHOULDER, THE BEST PROCEDURE IS:
opcionesEn: USING MIRRORS AND TURN SIGNALS, EDGE GRADUALLY BACK ON THE ROAD.
USING MIRRORS AND TURN SIGNALS, TURN SHARPLY TO GET BACK ON THE ROAD.
DRIVE ON THE SHOULDER TO THE NEXT EXIT AND THE RE-ENTER THE ROAD.

preguntaEn: WHENEVER YOU DOUBLE YOUR SPEED, YOUR VEHICLE HAS ABOUT________ TIMES OF DESTRUCTIVE POWER IF IT CRASHES?
opcionesEn: TWO.
THREE.
FOUR.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT OVERHEAD CLEARANCE IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD ASSUME POSTED CLEARANCE SIGNS ARE CORRECT.
THE WEIGHT OF A VEHICLE CHANGES ITS HEIGHT.
IF THE ROAD SURFACE CAUSES YOUR VEHICLE TO TILT TOWARS OBJECTS AT THE EDGE OF THE ROAD, YOU SHOULD DRIVE CLOSE TO THE SHOULDER.

preguntaEn: A GOOD INDICATION THAT ICE IS FORMING ON THE ROADWAY IS WHEN:
opcionesEn: YOU CAN SEE SPRAY FROM OTHER VEHICLES.
YOU OUTSIDE MIRRORS HAVE ICE ON THEM.
YOU CANNOT SEE THE EXHAUST OF THE VEHICLES.

preguntaEn: YOU NEED AT LEAST ___ INCH TREAD DEPTH IN EVERY MAJOR GROOVE OF YOUR FRONT TIRES.
WHEN SHOULD YOU TEST YOUR PARKING BREAK?
opcionesEn: WHILE MOVING AT VERY LOW SPEED.
WHILE THE VEHICLE IS PARKED.
WHEN BACKING.

preguntaEn: WHAT THREE DISTANCES ADD UP THE TOTAL STOPPING DISTANCE FOR YOUR TRUCK OR BUS?
opcionesEn: ATTENTION, DISTANCE, REACTION DISTANCE, SLOWING DISTANCE.
OBSERVATION DISTANCE, RESPOND DISTANCE, BRAKING DISTANCE.
PERCEPTION DISTANCE, REACTION DISTANCE, BRAKING DISTANCE.

preguntaEn: TIRES CHAINS:
opcionesEn: SHOULD ALWAYS BE CARRIED WHEN DRIVING IN WINTER WEATHER.
SHOULD NEVER BE USED ON ASPHALT.
SHOULD ONLY BE USED ON TH DRIVE WHEELS.

preguntaEn: HEAVY VEHICLES OFTEN MOVE SLOWER THAN OTHERS. WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A GOOD RULE TO FOLLOW WHILE DRIVING A HEAVY VEHICLE?
opcionesEn: STAY ON A RIGHT SIDE OF THE ROAD.
USE FOUR-WAY FLASHERS IF IT IS LEGAL IN YOUR STATE.
SIGNAL OTHER DRIVERS WHEN IT IS SAFE TO PASS YOU.

preguntaEn: DURING A VEHICLE INSPECTION, CHECKING THE ________ WILL NOT HELP PREVENT A FIRE?
opcionesEn: CARGO VENTILATION.
BATTERY FLUID LEVEL.
ELECTRICAL SYSTEM INSULATION.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD USE YOUR MIRRORS TO CHECK_______.
opcionesEn: BLIND SPOTS.
IF YOU RUNNIN LIGHTS ARE WORKING PROPERLY.
WHERE THE REAR OF YOUR VEHICLE IS WHILE YOU MAKE TURNS.

preguntaEn: TO PREVENT A LOAD FROM SHIFTING, THERE SHOULD BE AT LEAST ONE TIEDOWN FOR EVERY______ FEET OF CARGO.
WHICH FIRES CAN YOU USE WATER TO PUT OUT?
opcionesEn: TIRES FIRES.
GASOLINE FIRES.
ELECTRICAL FIRES.

preguntaEn: HOW DOES VEHICLE WEIGHT AFFECT STOPPING?
opcionesEn: FULLY LOADED TRUCKS TAKE LONGER TO STOP OR THE BUSES LOADED WITH PASSENGERS TAKE LESS DISTANCE THAN EMPTY ONES.
IT DOESN’T, BRAKES WORK THE SAME NO MATTER THE WEIGHT OF THE VEHICLE FOR BOTH TRUCKS AND BUSES.
EMPTY TRUCK TAKE LONGER TO STOP THAN IF LOADED, BUT THIS IS NOT THE NORMALLY CASE FOR BUSES.

preguntaEn: TO AVOID AN ACCIDENT YOU MOVED TO THE SHOULDER. TO RETURN TO THE ROAD.
opcionesEn: RIDE ON SHOULDER TO THE NEXT EXIT AND THE RE-ENTER THE ROAD.
USING MIRRORS AND TURN SIGNALS TURN SHARPLY TO GET BACK TO THE ROAD.
USING MIRRORS AND TURN SIGNALS RETURN WHEN THE ROAD IS CLEAR.

preguntaEn: IF YOU ARE STOPPED AT A ROADSIDE REST AREA AND FOUND TO HAVE A BAC (BLOOD ALCOHOL CONCENTRATION) OF 0.02 YOU WILL:
opcionesEn: BE PLACED OUT OF SERVICE FOR 72 HOURS.
BE IN DEEP TROUBLE WITH YOUR DISPATCHER.
BE PLACED OUT OF SERVICE FOR 24 HOURS.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE TRAVELING DOWN A LONG, STEEP HILL. YOUR BRAKES GET SO HOT THAT THEY FAIL. WHAT SHOULD YOU DO?
opcionesEn: DOWNSHIFT AND PUMP THE BRAKE PEDAL.
LOOK FOR AN ESCAPE RAMP OR ESCAPE ROUTE.
BOTH OF THE ABOVE.

preguntaEn: IF YOU DO NOT HAVE A CB RADIO, WHAT IS THE FIRST THING YOU SHOULD DO AT AN ACCIDENT SCENE?
opcionesEn: PROTECT THE AREA.
NOTIFY THE AUTHORITY.
CARE FOR THE INJURED PERSON.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS CORRECT ABOUT EMERGENCY OR EVASIVE ACTION?
opcionesEn: IN ORDER TO TURN QUICKLY, YOU MUST HAVE A FIRM GRIP ON THE STEERING WHEEL.
YOU CAN USUALLY STOP MORE QUICKLY THAN YOU CAN TURN TO MISS OBSTACLES.
STOPPING IS ALWAYS THE SAFEST THING TO DO IN AN EMERGENCY.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE BEST DESCRIBE HOW YOU SHOULD USE THE BRAKE PEDAL ON A STEEP DOWNHILL GRADE?
opcionesEn: LIGHT, PUMPING ACTION.
LIGHT, STEADY PRESSURE.
REPEATED STRONG PRESSURE THEN RELEASE.

preguntaEn: CONTROLLED BRAKING IS:
opcionesEn: SLAMMING ON THE BRAKES HARD AND MAKING WHEELS LOCK UP.
SQUEEZING THE BRAKES FIRMLY WITHOUT LOCKING THEM UP.
PRESSING BRAKES UNTIL WHEEL LOCK-UP OCCURS, RELEASING AND THEN REAPPLYING.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT CERTAIN TYPES OF CARGO IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: UNSTABLE LOADS SUCH AS HANGING MEAT OR LIVESTOCK CAN REQUIRE EXTRA CAUTION ON CURVES.
OVERSIZE LOADS CAN BE HAULED WITHOUT A SPECIAL PERMITS DURING TIMES WHEN THE ROADS ARE NOT BUSY.
WHEN LIQUIDS ARE HAULED, THE TANK SHOULD ALWAYS BE LOADED TOTALLY FULL.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THE FOLLOWING IS RECOMMENDED AS A WAY OF PREVENTING FATIGUE ON A LONG TRIP?
opcionesEn: STOP PERIODICALLY FOR REST AND EXERCISE.
KEEP THE VEHICLE CLOSED AND HEATED.
TAKE AN OVER- THE COUNTER.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT TRUE?
opcionesEn: ALCOHOL GOES DIRECTLY FROM THE STOMACH TO THE BLOOD STREAM.
A DRINKER CAN CONTROL HOW FAST HIS OR HER BODY ABSORBS AND GETS RID OF ALCOHOL.
BAC IS DETERMINED BY HOW FAST YOU DRINK, HOW MUCH YOU DRINK, AND YOUR WEIGHT.

preguntaEn: HAVING ANTILOCK BRAKES ON ONLY THE TRACTOR WITH:
opcionesEn: GIVE YOU MORE CONTROL OVER THE VEHICLE WHEN BRAKING.
INCREASE THE LIKEHOOD OF JACKKNIFING WHEN BRAKING.
INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD OF REAR WHEEL SKID WHEN BRAKING.

preguntaEn: WHAT IS THE PROPER WAY TO HOLD A STEERING WHEEL?
opcionesEn: WITH BOTH HANDS CLOSE TOGETHER, NEAR THE TOP OF THE WHEEL.
WITH BOTH HANDS CLOSE TOGETHER, NEAR THE BOTTOM OF THE WHEEL.
WITH BOTH HANDS, ON THE OPPOSITE SIDES OF THE WHEEL.

preguntaEn: ABS (ANTILOCK BRAKES) BRAKES:
opcionesEn: GIVE YOU MORE CONTROL OVER THE VEHICLE WHEN BRAKING.
INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD OF JACKKNIFING WHEN BRAKING.
INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD OF A REAR WHEEL SKID WHEN BRAKING.

preguntaEn: WHEN APPROACHING A BRIDGE ON A TWO-LANE ROAD, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: DRIVE IN THE CENTER OF THE BRIDGE.
CHECK THE WEIGHT LIMIT OF THE BRIDGE.
SLOW DOWN TO 25 MPH ON THE BRIDGE.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS ESPECIALLY TRUE ABOUT YOUR TIRES IN HOT WEATHER?
opcionesEn: A SMALL AMOUNT OF AIR SHOULD BE LET OUT SO AIR PRESSURE REMAINS STEADY.
YOU SHOULD CHECK TIRE MOUNTING AND AIR PRESSURE BEFORE DRIVING.
IF A TIRE IS TOO HOT TO TOUCH, YOU SHOULD HOSE IT DOWN WITH WATER.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT BACKING A HEAVY VEHICLE IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD AVOID BACKING WHENEVER YOU CAN.
HELPERS SHOULD BE OUT OF THE DRIVER’S SIGHT AND THEY SHOULD USE ONLY VOICE (SPOKEN) SIGNALS TO COMMUNICATE WITH THE DRIVER.
IT IS SAFER TO BACK TOWARD THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE VEHICLE THAN TOWARD THE DRIVER’S SIDE.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING A HEAVY VEHICLE. YOU MUST EXIT A HIGHWAY USING AN OFF-RAMP THAT CURVES DOWNHILL YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: SLOW TO THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT FOR THE OFF-RAMP.
SLOW DOWN TO 5 MPH BELOW THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT.
SLOW DOWN TO 15 MPH BELOW THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS A GOOD THING TO DO WHEN DRIVING AT NIGHT?
opcionesEn: KEEP YOUR SPEED SLOW ENOUGH THAT YOU CAN STOP WITHIN THE RANGE OF YOUR HEADLIGHTS.
LOOK DIRECTLY AT ONCOMING HEADLIGHTS ONLY BRIEFLY.
KEEP YOUR INSTRUMENT LIGHTS BRIGHT.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS USUALLY TRUE ABOUT DRIVING IN TUNNELS?
opcionesEn: HEADLIGHTS ARE REQUIRED BY LAW.
THERE MAY BE CROSSWINDS WHEN EXITING.
SPEEDS ARE LIMITED TO 30 MPH. OR LESS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT PART OF THE PRE-TRIP INSPECTION OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT?
opcionesEn: VALVE CLEARANCE.
ENGINE OIL LEVEL.
WORN ELECTRICAL WIRING INSULATION.

preguntaEn: IF A TRACTOR, TRUCK OR BUS HAS ANTILOCK BRAKES AND THE YELLOW ABS MALFUNCTION LAMP LIGHTS UP ON THE INSTRUMENT PANEL WHEN YOU UNDERWAY:
opcionesEn: YOUR VEHICLES’S ABS MAY NOT BE FUNCTIONING.
THE ROADWAY MAY BE SLICK.
YOUR BRAKE FLUID MAY BE LOW.

preguntaEn: WHEN YOU ARE DRIVING ON A SNOW-PACKED ROAD, YOU SHOULD REDUCE YOUR SPEED BY:
opcionesEn: ¼.
½
½.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD ALWAYS TURN ON YOUR 4-WAY EMERGENCY FLASHERS WHEN YOU:
opcionesEn: DRIVE TROUGH THE MOUNTAINS.
PARK ON THE SIDE OF THE ROAD.
CROSS RAILROAD TRACKS.

preguntaEn: WHAT IS NOT TRUE ABOUT BAD WEATHER AND DRIVING CONDITIONS?
opcionesEn: WHEN THE TEMPERATURE DROPS, THE BRIDGE WILL FREEZE BEFORE ROADS WILL.
THE ROAD IS MORE SLIPPERY AS RAIN CONTINUES THAN WHEN RAIN BEGINS.
DRIVING CONDITIONS BECAME MORE DANGEROUS AS THE TEMPERATURE RISES ABOVE FREEZING.

preguntaEn: FOR THE FIRST OFFENCE OF DRIVING A COMMERCIAL VEHICLE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOL OR DRUGS, YOU WILL LOSE YOUR CDL FOR AT LEAST________.
opcionesEn: 1 YEAR.
6 MONTH.
2 YEARS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS TRUE ABOUT YOUR OVERHEAD CLEARANCE?
opcionesEn: WARNINGS ARE ALWAYS POSTED FOR LOW CLEARANCE AREAS LIKES BRIDGES AND OVERPASSES.
THE WEIGHT OF CARGO CAN CHANGE THE HEIGHT OF YOUR VEHICLE.
PAVING A ROAD DOES NOT AFFECT THE CLEARANCE HEIGHT UNDER BRIDGES OR OVERPASSES.

preguntaEn: THE CENTER OF GRAVITY OF A LOAD:
opcionesEn: SHOULD BE KEPT AS HIGH AS POSSIBLE.
CAN MAKE A VEHICLE MORE LIKELY TO TIP OVER ON CURVES IF IT IS HIGH.
IS ONLY A PROBLEM IF THE VEHICLE IS OVERLOADED.

preguntaEn: TO PREVENT BRAKE ‘’FADE’’, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: COAST DOWN HILLS THAT ARE NOT VERY STEEP INCLINES.
APPLY CONSTANT HARD PRESSURE ON THE BRAKES WHEN DRIVING DOWN HILLS.
SELECT A GEAR, WHICH WILL KEEP YOUR VEHICLE TO A SAFE SPEED ON THE DEEP DOWNGRADE.

preguntaEn: MOST SERIOUS SKID RESULTS FROM:
opcionesEn: DRIVING TOO FAST FOR CONDITIONS.
TURNING TOO SHARPLY.
AN UNEVEN LOAD.

preguntaEn: IF YOU NEED TO LEAVE THE ROAD IN A TRAFFIC EMERGENCY, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: TRY TO GET ALL WHEELS OFF THE PAVEMENT.
AVOID BRAKING UNTIL YOUR SPEED HAS DROPPED TO ABOUT 20 MPH.
AVOID THE SHOULDER BECAUSE MOST SHOULDERS WILL NOT SUPPORT A LARGE VEHICLE.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS TRUE ABOUT NOTIFYING THE AUTHORITIES AFTER AN ACCIDENT OCCURS?
opcionesEn: AN EXACT LOCATION IS NOT NECESSARY, JUST IDENTIFY THE ROAD AND THE VEHICLES INVOLVED.
YOU SHOULD NOTIFY AUTHORITIES ABOUT AN ACCIDENT BEFORE DOING ANYTHING ELSE.
IF YOU HAVE A CELLULAR PHONE OR CB RADIO, YOU SHOULD NOTIFY THE AUTHORITIES BEFORE EXITING YOUR VEHICLE.

preguntaEn: YOU DRIVE THROUGH THE HEAVY RAIN OR SNOW. YOU CAN HARDLY SEE WHAR IS GOING ON OUTSIDE. YOU CAN LET THE OTHER DRIVERS KNOW ABOUT YOU BY:
opcionesEn: USING YOUR HORN.
TURNING ON INSIDE CAB LIGHTS.
TURNING ON THE LOW-BEAM HEADLIGHTS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE WOULD PROBABLY NOT HELP IF WINDSHIELD COVERED WITH ICE?
opcionesEn: BRUSH.
SCRAPER.
DEFROSTER.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT SOMETHING YOU SHOULD DO IF YOUR HEADLIGHTS ARE NOT WORKING PROPERLY?
opcionesEn: LEAVE ON YOUR HIGH BEAMS.
CLEAN THE HEADLIGHTS.
ADJUST THE HEADLIGHTS.

preguntaEn: AGGRESSIVE DRIVING IS:
opcionesEn: DRIVING A VEHICLE WITH THE INTENT TO DO HARM TO OTHERS.
DRIVING A VEHICLE IN A SELFISH, BOLD OR PUSHY MANNER.
DRIVING A VEHICLE WHEN YOUR FULL ATTENTION IS NOT ON DRIVING.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE CHECKING YOUR TIRES FOR A PRE-TRIP INSPECTION. WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: TIRES OF MISMATCHED SIZES SHOULD NOT BE USED ON THE SAME VEHICLE.
RADIAL AND BIAS-PLY TIRES CAN BE USED TOGETHER ON THE SAME VEHICLE.
2/32 INCH TREAD DEPTH IS SAFE FOR THE FRONT TIRES.
